styleHint: STYLE: a single chess piece rendered as a chunky retrofuture game sprite for the slop.computer desktop — front-facing (NOT isometric), bold simple silhouette that stays instantly recognizable at 32 pixels, soft-3D chunky shading like a classic Mac OS 9 game asset. CYPHERPUNK FLAVOR: early-internet BBS vaporwave Y2K cyberdelic. Transparent background. Exactly ONE piece, centered, filling ~85% of the frame height. No text, no chess board, no border, no shadow plate, no reflection.
